existing.description: The Alfred Werner Scholarship Program of the SCS Foundation, a partner organisation of the Swiss Chemical Society, supports highly talented international students who obtained their BSc outside Switzerland and wish to pursue an MSc in Chemistry, Biochemistry or the Pharmaceutical Sciences at a Swiss university or one of the Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology. The scholarship amounts to CHF 36,000, previously CHF 30,000, and is supported by the Swiss chemical and pharmaceutical industry and private donors. Scholarships are awarded to candidates nominated by the academic institutions to which they have been admitted; the Foundation does not accept direct applications. The current call covers Master's Student Scholarships 2027-2029 with a submission deadline of 25 March 2027.
eligibility: BSc obtained from a university outside Switzerland
Admitted to an MSc in Chemistry, Biochemistry or the Pharmaceutical Sciences at a Swiss university or one of the Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology (ETH, EPFL)
Nominated by the academic institution to which the candidate has been admitted
Nominations reviewed by the Alfred Werner Fund Allocation Committee, whose members are appointed by the participating companies and academic institutions

existing.notes: The amount was raised from CHF 30,000 to CHF 36,000 and the official page records it explicitly, so a single funding_amount is reported. Nomination-only access is the defining constraint of this award and is often mis-stated as an open application. The supporting network spans dsm-firmenich, Givaudan, F. Hoffmann-La Roche, Merck/Sigma-Aldrich, Novartis, Syngenta and Metrohm Stiftung on the industry side, and the Universities of Basel, Bern, Geneva, Neuchatel and Zurich plus EPFL and ETH on the academic side. The page is internally inconsistent about totals, stating 95 scholars since 2013 in the introduction, 88 between 2013 and 2024 in Facts and Figures, and 48 in a historical statement by a former president; the Facts and Figures range is the most recent. required_documents is left empty because the official page does not publish a nomination dossier list.
